target.title: fix(diagnostic): avoid model-call stream hot-path object copies
target.body:
Related: #91588
Related: #97211

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where diagnostic model-call event accounting still copies stream chunks and model-call event bases with object rest/spread on hot paths. Issue #91588 includes field evidence that points at V8 dictionary-mode `CopyDataProperties` work around the diagnostic stream byte-accounting path during long-running Gateway workloads.

Scope boundary: This PR only addresses diagnostic model-call stream copy/spread hot paths; it does not close the broader Gateway RSS/OOM tracker or prove multi-day RSS plateau.

## Why This Change Was Made

The change removes object rest from `responseStreamChunkByteLengthUnchecked()` and conditional object spreads from `baseModelCallEvent()` while keeping the same diagnostic event fields. The stream copy now uses a null-prototype target so an own enumerable `__proto__` stream-chunk field remains a data key instead of interacting with `Object.prototype` behavior.

This PR is opened as a draft because current validation is focused on regression coverage and PR-level checks; longer-running Gateway RSS proof is still outside this submission's current evidence.

## User Impact

Operators running long-lived Gateway sessions should get less diagnostic hot-path object-copy churn during model-call streaming. The change is diagnostic-internal and does not intentionally alter model responses, provider transport, or persisted session data.

## Breaking changes (if any)

None expected.

## Implementation

- Replace `{ partial, ...snapshotlessChunk }` on stream chunks with an explicit `Object.keys()` copy into `Object.create(null)`, skipping only `partial`.
- Keep own enumerable `__proto__` chunk fields as JSON-serializable data keys and add regression coverage for that behavior.
- Build `baseModelCallEvent()` once and assign optional fields conditionally instead of using conditional spread literals.
- Add regression coverage that non-delta chunk byte accounting does not read a `partial` getter.

## Labels considered

`P0`, `impact:session-state`, `impact:message-loss`, `impact:crash-loop`, `clawsweeper:fix-shape-clear`, `clawsweeper:needs-live-repro`, and `clawsweeper:no-new-fix-pr` from #91588 were considered when setting this PR's narrow scope and draft status.

## Validation

Current head: `0f2f23617ad992b26e9055bcbb441fb952396988`

Local pre-check only:

- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` — passed with no output.
- `corepack pnpm test src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.model-diagnostic-events.test.ts` — passed: 1 test file, 20 tests, process exit code 0.

GitHub Actions/check read-back after opening:

- `Real behavior proof` — passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28604487138/job/84821024257
- `actionlint` — passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28604472220/job/84820971449
- `no-tabs` — passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28604472220/job/84820971536
- `runner-admission` — passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28604472204/job/84820972066
- `Detect iOS scan scope` — passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/28604472238/job/84820971685

At read-back time, the status rollup also contained skipped path/draft-selected jobs and two cancelled superseded check runs.

## Evidence source map

- Issue field evidence: #91588 contains public native stack evidence around V8 `Runtime_CopyDataPropertiesWithExcludedPropertiesOnStack` / dictionary-key collection and identifies the diagnostic stream chunk copy site.
- Regression tests: `attempt.model-diagnostic-events.test.ts` covers partial snapshot exclusion without reading `partial` and preserves own enumerable `__proto__` data-key byte accounting.
- GitHub Actions/checks: PR-level checks listed above passed on this head.
- Local pre-check only: focused test and diff whitespace check listed above.

## Risk

- Diagnostic byte accounting can be sensitive to unusual provider stream chunk shapes. The added tests cover the two relevant edge cases from the review context: skipping `partial` without reading it and preserving an own enumerable `__proto__` data key.
- This does not address diagnostic maps, session retention, plugin retention, or other long-running RSS contributors discussed in #91588.
- The implementation avoids provider/runtime behavior changes and is limited to diagnostic event construction and byte accounting.

## Rollback

Revert this PR. No data migration, config migration, or persisted format change is involved.

## Docs updated

No documentation files were changed. The patch is limited to diagnostic implementation code plus focused regression tests.

## Related issue / PR

- Related: #91588
- Related: #97211

#97211 covers the same diagnostic hot path and has public review feedback around proof, scope, and `__proto__` behavior. This PR carries focused regression tests and uses non-closing issue references so it does not auto-close the broader Gateway RSS/OOM tracker.

## Not tested / Limitations

- No multi-day Gateway RSS plateau/soak proof is included here.
- No claim is made that this fixes all memory growth sources in #91588.
